name: DocuSeal
description: DocuSeal hosted or self-hosted API for templates, PDF/DOCX/HTML ingestion, submissions, submitters, completed document downloads, cloning, merging, and lifecycle management. Webhook URLs and events are configured in the DocuSeal admin settings.

credential_fields.name: base_url
credential_fields.label: API Base URL
credential_fields.description: Use https://api.docuseal.com for DocuSeal Cloud, or the origin of your self-hosted API without a trailing slash.

tools.name: list_submissions
tools.description: List submissions with pagination, status, template, and date filters.

tools.name: get_submission
tools.description: Get one submission, its submitters, fields, status, and audit metadata.

tools.name: list_submission_documents
tools.description: Return temporary download URLs for completed documents in a submission.

tools.name: create_submission
tools.description: Create a signing submission from an existing template. Each submitter maps a template role to an email or phone and can include prefilled fields, values, metadata, and redirect settings.

tools.name: create_submission_from_pdf
tools.description: Create a template and submission in one call from PDF URL/base64 documents. Define submitters and fields for each document.

documents.description: Documents with name and file URL or base64 content.

tools.name: create_submission_from_docx
tools.description: Create a template and submission from DOCX URL/base64 documents. Text tags in the files can define fields and roles.

tools.name: create_submission_from_html
tools.description: Create a template and submission from HTML document definitions.

documents.description: Documents containing name and html strings.

tools.name: update_submission
tools.description: Update submission settings or submitter identity, values, metadata, and delivery controls.

tools.name: delete_submission
tools.description: Permanently delete a submission and its signing links.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List templates with pagination, folder, archive, and search filters.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Get template documents, submitter roles, fields, and settings.

tools.name: create_template_from_pdf
tools.description: Create a reusable template from PDF URLs or base64 documents and explicit field definitions.

tools.name: create_template_from_docx
tools.description: Create a reusable template from DOCX URLs or base64 documents, including text-tag fields.

tools.name: create_template_from_html
tools.description: Create a reusable template from HTML documents.

tools.name: clone_template
tools.description: Clone a template, optionally into a new folder or name.

tools.name: merge_templates
tools.description: Merge multiple templates into a new template while preserving roles and fields.

tools.name: update_template
tools.description: Update template name, folder, external ID, submitter roles, or fields.

tools.name: update_template_documents
tools.description: Replace or reorder the source documents attached to a template.
